queries_run: Experian TransUnion Equifax credit rating downgrade OR guidance cut 2026

findings.claim: Experian、TransUnion、Equifax 三家合計占 FICO 營收 FY2026 60%、FY2025 51%、FY2024 45%。
findings.excerpt: During fiscal 2026, 2025 and 2024, revenues generated from our agreements with Experian, TransUnion and Equifax collectively accounted for 60%, 51% and 45% of our total revenues, respectively.

findings.claim: 三家 CRA 各自占營收超過 10%；2026-09-30 有三個客戶各占應收帳款 10% 以上（前一年為兩個）。
findings.excerpt: with all three consumer reporting agencies each contributing more than 10% of our total revenues in each of fiscal 2026, 2025 and 2024. At September 30, 2026 and September 30, 2025, three customers and two customers, respectively, accounted for 10% or more of total consolidated receivables.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素揭露依賴少數客戶（含三大 CRA），客戶規模較大、議價力強，條款可能被重談或終止。
findings.excerpt: We rely on relatively few customers, including our contracts with the three major consumer reporting agencies, for a significant portion of our revenues and profits. Many of our customers are significantly larger than we are and may have greater bargaining power, which could negatively impact the terms of our commercial agreements.

findings.claim: 搜尋未見三大 CRA 遭信用評等調降；僅見 Equifax 下調 2026 營收指引（美國房貸業務疲弱）及券商調降評等（Oppenheimer、RBC），為股票評等非信用評等。
findings.source: WebSearch 彙整結果（Equifax FY26 guidance cut 等聚合報導）
findings.excerpt: Equifax FY26 Results: Sales guidance cut to $6.646B-$6.676B

customer_concentration_credit.note: 未查到 CRA 信用評等行動；Equifax 指引下修日期依聚合站，為推估。
